host_about:
Now we are running 2 guest rooms in major spots in Tokyo, Kagurazaka and Ginza. Both the neighborhoods have interesting historical background and best accumulations of the best cuisines, shops, and cultural facilities. 
We are trying to provide you nicely-designed cozy space in the middle of interesting neighborhood. Please enjoy the atmosphere of the town as one of the member of dwellers!

===
[Studio-D, Kagurazaka]

Even thought, Kagurazaka is located in the middle of Tokyo, this neightborehood still has Japanese traditional atmosphere. Visit Kagurazaka to find another face of Tokyo.

The main road of Kagurazaka was once at the outer edge of Edo Castle, opposite the Ushigome bridge over the castle moat, and has always been busy because of this privileged location. In the early 20th century, the area was renowned for its numerous geisha houses, of which several remain today. Currently, Kagurazaka is experiencing a popularity boom due to its traditional, sophisticated atmosphere on the edge of modern Shinjuku ward.

Kagurazaka is also widely regarded as an important center of Japanese cuisine. (2 of triple michelen stars, 3 of double Michelen stars are located in such a small neighborhood!!)
Several old and famous “ryotei” are to be found in the winding back streets, often accessible only by foot. These ryotei provide expensive “kaiseki” cuisine, which is generally regarded as the pinnacle of Japanese food. Ryotei also allow diners to invite geisha to provide entertainment during the course of the evening.
While it retains a traditional Japanese atmosphere, Kagurazaka now boasts a significant French presence with many French expatriates living in the area due to the proximity of l’Institut Franco-Japonais de Tokyo.

===
[WOW-GINZA]

The other one, GINZA, is one of the world famous commercial zone, just like 5th avenue in NYC, Piccadilly Circus in London. You can go into the area with just 5 mins walk from the room.
Not only shopping but there are so many resuaurant in GINZA. As "Opening a restaurant in Ginza" is most of all the restaurant owner's dream, there are many nice and sophisticated restaurants located in this area and competing their skills and plates every night! (2 of triple michelen stars, 15 of double Michelen stars are in GINZA area!) Not only the high-end's plates, but there are also millions of daily use drinking spots (Izakaya) for the office workers. You can enjoy the noise of town covered with chiken BBQ smoke,  on the street side table with a shot of Hot Sake!! 

The room, WOW-GINZA, is by the rail trucks from Tokyo station. You can see all kinds of trains crossing in each 5 mins. You can enjoy another facade of Tokyo!

This brand new house contains 3 bedrooms, spacious kitchen, sitting room and accommodates up to eight guests with options for two more. Or share between two or three couples for a relaxed retreat in Tokyo. We welcome groups and families
neighborhood_overview:
The house is in a quiet and safe street. The streets are fairly typical of suburban Tokyo and some urban hiking reveals interesting architecture as well as many green spaces.

On days when you want to stick close to home, the neighbourhood bustles with restaurants, cafes, bars, shops and other amenities. There is a grocery store nearby perfect for stocking breakfast and for snacks, we suggest any of the nearby convenience stores which are open 24 hours.

We've drawn up a neighborhood map to help you find what you need.

We have also included a selection of novels and travel brochures, walking maps and a Lonely Planet for you to use during your stay. We are happy to recommend out of the way places and local knowledge of our combined 20 years living in Tokyo.
host_about:
We help people from all around the world make the most of every moment in Tokyo. We’re proud long-term Tokyo residents, passionate about the beautiful diversity our world has to offer. We’ve developed an incredibly deep connection with our Tokyo community, culture, and city - and we can’t wait to share it with you.

We're an Australian husband and wife team who have built up a network of homes for short term rentals with like minded hosts and owners called Tokyo Family Stays. 

With more than 20 years of experience as proud Tokyoites, we know how to provide experiences you won’t find through any hotel or “luxury” service. We bring you true humility and raw humanity, maximizing your time here so you can take home unforgettable memories.

We’ve hosted thousands of guests to date, many of whom come back every year. Our real-life friend list never stops growing, and we can’t wait to make you a part of it!  

Let us also introduce: Tokyo - a Colorful City of Diversity

This global tourist hub continues to WOW visitors worldwide. While many consider Tokyo daunting in terms of language and cultural barriers, we see an opportunity in every challenge. Our job is to help you navigate this beautiful city and make the most of your business or leisure trip, in a home designed to deliver comfort and local flavor. We provide all you need to maximize your stay in your neighborhood of choice, with varied transport options, house layouts, and furnishings modern and traditional.
Let us show you our city.

The apartment is located in a quiet residential area, where you feel the lifestyle of locals. There area is mixed up with urban apartments, older houses, vintage car repair factories and a beautiful temple. There are bus stops a short walk away which will take you to Shibuya, Ebisu, Meguro, Shinjuku, Roppongi, etc. etc. You can also walk to 3 train stations within 10 mins, which will basically take you anywhere in the city.

We are about a 10 min walk away from the famous Azabu Juban area, which is one of the most charming, popular and prestigious areas of Tokyo. host_about:
Hello! My name is Motoki. I love to travel, especially when meeting new people and sharing each values, knowledges and experiences there. So I made up my mind to open BLENDIA to do that even on my daily life, and also to let the guests experience the most fantastic moment of the travel as well. In the beginning of 2015, after 6 months of preparation, I finally opened here, and welcomed more than 600 guests in nearly 2 years. 

BLENDIA, the name of this guesthouse came from the coffee blend. On the blending process, it's required to understand each beans contained in a blend. They are coming from all over the world, and each one has special flavors or tastes. Bitter, fruity, dark, sour...everything is very different, but should be understood all.

I manage this guest house with my friend Shigeo Kojima.

My introduction
I like to talk to people from different countries. 

I'm a designer and also an owner of the shared house where people study English.

My purpose for doing B&B is to make people from other countries happy and to have them enjoyed the best staying in Japan.

I'd like people to know not only one side of Japan ( ex. Asakusa, Shibuya, Akihabara ), but also the other side ( local food , culture , people ).

While I'm introducing Japan to foreigners, I'd also like to have Japanese people experienced talking and hanging out with them.
People from my shared house are willing to spend time with travelers.

I like eating, drinking, reading and bourldering.


************************************************
Shigeo Kojima

Hello,
I like to introduce Japanese usual cultures.
I have a lot of wonderful friends any places in a world.
I'm a watchmaker for Swiss watch brand in Tokyo.
I like traveling, taking photos and go out drinking with my friends.

I also have an apartment to lend myself in other place.

My place is not gorgeous but have a good atmosphere I think.
There are traditional temple and special tram around house.You might take nice photos that haven't been introduced on guidebooks.

The closest station is Zoshigaya on Hukutoshi-line Tokyo metro.
It takes 20 second by walk.
You could access to Shibuya in 17 min and Ikebukuro in 2min (one stop) on Yamamoto-line JR. by this line.
And you could use Mejiro station on Yamabnote-line JR. It takes 10 min by walk.
And also you could use a Tram: kishibojin station.
It takes 1 min by walk. It's very convenience to access to all of main part of Tokyo.
I'like you to have a wonderful time in Tokyo!


************************************************
Mayu

Hi, I'm hosting here with Takeshi.  

I'm from Gifu located in the central Japan, which has great nature, very good spas
and unique food culture.

I like making Japanese fermentation seasoning such as Miso, soy source
and salted rice malt. They are very good for the health, and they can
change the tastes of the food better.
Winter is great season for making Miso. If the timing's right, please
make it together;) It will be a good memory and experience in Japan.

By the way, Tokyo has lots of great food!(I love to eat delicious
food very much!)
I'd like you to try Ramen, Monjya-yaki and Izakaya.

You can eat them in the neighborhood or ask me anything you would like to eat.

Besides food,
I like "Meiji shrine", near Harajuku very much. I recommend you to try Omikuji
 (they're sacred lots drawn at temples or shrines to tell one's fortune) there. 
"Hamarikyu", Japanese traditional garden is popular among foreign people.
"Tsukiji fish market" is also fun!

Hope you enjoy and like Tokyo!

host_about:
I manage this guest house with my friend Shigeo Kojima.

My introduction
I like to talk to people from different countries. 

I'm a designer and also an owner of the shared house where people study English.

My purpose for doing B&B is to make people from other countries happy and to have them enjoyed the best staying in Japan.

I'd like people to know not only one side of Japan ( ex. Asakusa, Shibuya, Akihabara ), but also the other side ( local food , culture , people ).

While I'm introducing Japan to foreigners, I'd also like to have Japanese people experienced talking and hanging out with them.
People from my shared house are willing to spend time with travelers.

I like eating, drinking, reading and bourldering.


************************************************
Shigeo Kojima

Hello,
I like to introduce Japanese usual cultures.
I have a lot of wonderful friends any places in a world.
I'm a watchmaker for Swiss watch brand in Tokyo.
I like traveling, taking photos and go out drinking with my friends.

I also have an apartment to lend myself in other place.

My place is not gorgeous but have a good atmosphere I think.
There are traditional temple and special tram around house.You might take nice photos that haven't been introduced on guidebooks.

The closest station is Zoshigaya on Hukutoshi-line Tokyo metro.
It takes 20 second by walk.
You could access to Shibuya in 17 min and Ikebukuro in 2min (one stop) on Yamamoto-line JR. by this line.
And you could use Mejiro station on Yamabnote-line JR. It takes 10 min by walk.
And also you could use a Tram: kishibojin station.
It takes 1 min by walk. It's very convenience to access to all of main part of Tokyo.
I'like you to have a wonderful time in Tokyo!


************************************************
Mayu

Hi, I'm hosting here with Takeshi.  

I'm from Gifu located in the central Japan, which has great nature, very good spas
and unique food culture.

I like making Japanese fermentation seasoning such as Miso, soy source
and salted rice malt. They are very good for the health, and they can
change the tastes of the food better.
Winter is great season for making Miso. If the timing's right, please
make it together;) It will be a good memory and experience in Japan.

By the way, Tokyo has lots of great food!(I love to eat delicious
food very much!)
I'd like you to try Ramen, Monjya-yaki and Izakaya.

You can eat them in the neighborhood or ask me anything you would like to eat.

Besides food,
I like "Meiji shrine", near Harajuku very much. I recommend you to try Omikuji
 (they're sacred lots drawn at temples or shrines to tell one's fortune) there. 
"Hamarikyu", Japanese traditional garden is popular among foreign people.
"Tsukiji fish market" is also fun!

Hope you enjoy and like Tokyo!

民宿位于距离连接成田机场，贯穿东京都的JR总武线新小岩站北口，步行10分钟的商店街上。
新小岩在日本被称为"下城”。"下城“的意思也就是城乡结合部的意思。车站附近有都心商业区的繁华，也有符合日本人生活习俗的商店街。是体验日本习俗的好去处。新小岩地区就是介绍日本人生活习俗和民情的大型系列电影≪寅次郎的故事≫中主人公寅次郎的家乡。新小岩车站附近非常繁华，有各种饮食店、24小时营业的大型超市和唐吉柯德店，是买礼品的好去处。还有营业到深夜的药妆店。车站南口有一条封闭式的商店街，是茶余饭后散步购物的好地方。
本民宿（日式风格）处于新小岩车站北口的商店街上，商店街上有各种现做现卖日本料理的小店铺，距离超近，步行1分30秒之内。坐在家中就可以体验日本风情，享受日本料理。详情请看下面街区介绍。

I love Japan and the City of Tokyo. So many activities and events are holding on frequently, that's is one of the reason why I decided to keep living in Japan more more than 13years.

As a foreigner living here I can well understand what as a traveler should visiting and what should experience, these kind of feelings and minds I can sharing with all my guests.

Please feel free to contact with me for more info about Tokyo or Japan.

description:
Newly renovated apartment with custom made furniture. 6 min walk to Hatagaya station, which is 2 stops / 3 min to Shinjuku station by train. Straight into the skyscrapers and neon area. Many small restaurants, shops, ramen and local culture nearby.

The space
Our apartment is a simple apartment, but with nice quality objects. It's perfect for 1 or 2 people looking to explore Tokyo outside of the designated tourist areas but still have freedom and easy access to the rest of the city. The apartment is on the 7th floor of the building.

** PLEASE NOTE **
- The entrance of studio apartment is located on a fairly large road, so the noise may bother some people. For those who are sensitive to noise, please bring earplugs with you.

- To prevent damage in the apartment and entrance, bringing in large luggage or large amounts of luggage is not permitted. Also, using the apartment as a storage space/warehouse is strictly prohibited.
neighborhood_overview:
Hatagaya is a very convenient area for getting around Tokyo and it also has a great local feel, but only 3 minutes to Shinjuku station. Nishihara street, the local street in Hatagaya is great for taking a stroll along, it will give you the feeling of being a local in Tokyo. It has lots of great small shops and local Japanese restaurants as well as a local sento (bathhouse).

The local supermarket is close to the station, and convenience stores open 24hrs. Hatagaya has everything you need in Tokyo.

name: Traditional Wooden House and Bath!
description:
We run a Sentō, a Japanese public bath, in the Yanaka area. You can have the one and only experience of staying in a Japanese traditional wooden house that has been around for 90 years. Plus, you can take the traditional bath as many as you want!

The space
The building is a traditional Japanese wooden house built in 90 years ago. While you are staying, you can hear the sound of the Sentō, and you can feel transported back in time to the Edo period. You can have the one and only experience of staying at our Sentō. The living quarters are so spacious. There are showers in both the Sento and the living quarters. Coin washing machines are provided. There are three single beds up to five people can stay. We provide a high speed WiFi service.
For additional information, the renovation of our house will be completed shortly. From 1 September 2016, the house can accommodate up to eight guests with two bedrooms, five beds and three shower rooms.

Guest
neighborhood_overview: In Yanaka, there remains a lot of traditional Japanese houses which have survived from air raids in the war. Yanaka is one of the most popular places in Tokyo and many people visit here, not only people from overseas but also Japanese people. In this area, you can see a lot of shops and traditional Japanese life from different eras.
host_about:
Hello, I was born and brought up in Yanaka. I have lived here for forty years and have never lived anywhere else but in Yanaka. We run a Japanese Sento, a Japanese public bath, and I am the fourth-generation owner of the Sento that has been around since the Edo period. These days there are few Sento left in Japan. I keep the tradition and culture of Sento. 
 When I have free time, I go travelling abroad and have been to around thirty countries. I speak little English, but I've travelled alone a lot and I managed it on my own. I love sports. I am recently into surffing and used to be a professional MMA(Mixed Martial Arts) wrestler in Japan. I really like to talk to people, especially those from overseas, who have different bacgrounds from us. Normally I am really busy at work, but if we have time, I'd like to show you arond some local places in Yanaka or night spots in Tokyo! 

はじめまして こんにちは 私はこの谷中に生まれ40年間離れる事なく住み続けています｡仕事は今では数少ない銭湯の4代目として歴史ある文化を守り続けています｡ ﾌﾟﾗｲﾍﾞｰﾄでは今までに世界約30ｶ国くらいを旅しています 私は英語がほとんど話せませんがそのほとんどが一人旅でした｡私はｽﾎﾟｰﾂがとても好きです今はｻｰﾌｨﾝに夢中で 昔はMMAのﾌﾟﾛ選手として日本で戦っていました｡私は人と接するのがとても好きです､特に異文化の外国人と接するのにとても興味があります 仕事はとても忙しいですが時間が合えば是非日本の下町 谷中のﾃﾞｨｰﾌﾟな所や都心のﾅｲﾄｽﾎﾟｯﾄなど案内できたらと思います｡

host_about:
Hello, my name is Kenny Matsumura. You can call me “Kenny.”
 There is one indispensable thing when it comes to the history of myself which is the sport “cricket.”
 

 It’s me who started “cricket” in Japan which was a totally unknown sport in the country. It all started when I was a university student more than 25 years ago.
 From that time, I made every possible effort to expand the cricket base in Japan. Words cannot describe the hardships endured to make activities a success. 
 While running a real estate company on my own, I also serve as an adviser of the Japan Cricket Association which I established. I also spend half the week travelling around the country in order to teach cricket to the children as a volunteer.
 I was so happy when I became the first Japanese to receive the Lifetime Service Award from the International Cricket Council and when i was selected as one of the "1000 international figures" of the century in 2009.
 

 I really love Japanese food, especially Sushi and Yakitori (grilled chicken).

 Please fully enjoy Japan and have a great stay in Japan!!!!

The closest station from the apartment is Zoshigaya on Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line, which is only 5-6 minutes away from the apartment. You can easily access to Ikebukuro, one of the major cities of Tokyo, which has some attractions worth checking out such as Sunshine Aquarium and Animate (shop for animation and games). There are several spots where you can enjoy the cherry blossoms including Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden. Ikebukuro station is one of the major hubs in Tokyo, with JR lines (Yamanote, Saikyo, and Shonan-Shinjuku), Tokyo Metro lines (Marunouchi, Yurakucho, and Fukutoshin), Tobu Line, and Seibu Line all coming in and out. From Zoshigaya station, you can use Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line, which would take you to famous attractions such as Shinjuku, Harajuku, and Shibuya. The apartment itself is in a quiet neighborhood and it is hard to believe that it is right in the thick of mega-city Tokyo.

Now we are running 2 guest rooms in major spots in Tokyo, Kagurazaka and Ginza. Both the neighborhoods have interesting historical background and best accumulations of the best cuisines, shops, and cultural facilities. 
We are trying to provide you nicely-designed cozy space in the middle of interesting neighborhood. Please enjoy the atmosphere of the town as one of the member of dwellers!

===
[Studio-D, Kagurazaka]

Even thought, Kagurazaka is located in the middle of Tokyo, this neightborehood still has Japanese traditional atmosphere. Visit Kagurazaka to find another face of Tokyo.

The main road of Kagurazaka was once at the outer edge of Edo Castle, opposite the Ushigome bridge over the castle moat, and has always been busy because of this privileged location. In the early 20th century, the area was renowned for its numerous geisha houses, of which several remain today. Currently, Kagurazaka is experiencing a popularity boom due to its traditional, sophisticated atmosphere on the edge of modern Shinjuku ward.

Kagurazaka is also widely regarded as an important center of Japanese cuisine. (2 of triple michelen stars, 3 of double Michelen stars are located in such a small neighborhood!!)
Several old and famous “ryotei” are to be found in the winding back streets, often accessible only by foot. These ryotei provide expensive “kaiseki” cuisine, which is generally regarded as the pinnacle of Japanese food. Ryotei also allow diners to invite geisha to provide entertainment during the course of the evening.
While it retains a traditional Japanese atmosphere, Kagurazaka now boasts a significant French presence with many French expatriates living in the area due to the proximity of l’Institut Franco-Japonais de Tokyo.

description:
「天の原 ふりさけ見れば 春日なる 三笠の山に いでし月かも」~阿倍仲麻呂

閑静な住宅地を通り抜けた先に、ひっそりと佇む伝統的な木造家屋。小鳥のさえずりや四季を彩る花々など、美しい日本の原風景を独り占めすることができる贅沢な山荘です。山荘1Fの南側に広がるテラスは平安貴族の「月見台」を思わせる贅沢な空間です。

The space
「松」は、皎月山荘1Fに位置する、書院造りの和室続き間を寝室としてご利用頂くことができます。大きな床の間と書院のある八畳間と、襖で区切られた八畳間の二間をゆったりとお使いいただけます。
雪見障子の向こうには、南向きで日当たりの良い広縁廊下があり、窓の外には眺めの良いテラス「月見台」がございます。絵師による手描きの襖絵と優れた彫刻の欄間で飾られた豪華な和の空間が、あなたの特別なひとときを演出します。

//皎月山荘とは…//
皎月山荘は、江戸時代の北関東に見られる豪農好みの伝統様式を取り入れ、およそ50年前に建てられた邸宅です。優れた職人たちによって、当時手に入る最も良質な建材を用い、丹精込めて造られています。
玄関では、和風に仕立てられたガラスレリーフと貴重な亀甲竹の飾り柱が、お客様をお迎えします。マントルピースを備えた当時の応接室は、床に組み木のモザイクを用いて、昭和の和洋折衷の意匠をお楽しみいただけます。内庭に面する廊下の桁（けた）には15メートルを超える杉を絞り丸太にして使い、書院造りの続き間は絵師による手描きの襖絵や優れた彫刻による欄間によって飾られています。

皎月山荘は、都心１時間以内という立地を忘れさせてくれる、静かな佇まいを誇っております。ひとたび門を抜ければ、他の人家から隔絶された、大らかな自然の景色が眼前に広がります。
四季折々の花や紅葉の美しさはもちろん、夜は虫の声や星空を楽しみ、朝は小鳥のさえずりで目を覚ますことも。大きな南向きの窓から見おろす景色は季節毎に表情が変わり、豊かな自然をたっぷり味わっていただけます。

大切な家族や仲間と素敵な時間をお過ごし下さい。

リビング、ダイニング、風呂、ウォシュレットトイレ、冷暖房設備完備です

Quietly residing just beyond the city’s inner circle, Meguro District attracts commuters, families, and artists who appreciate subtle charms over sonorous environs. Tokyoites tend to visit Meguro District’s most famous local destinations, the hip enclave of Nakameguro and the canal along the Meguro River. Despite its far-away residential feel, Meguro District never seems out of touch. Organic cafes, famous izakayas, repurposed vintage shops, and musty must-see bookstores generate enough buzz to sustain this understatedly cool neighborhood.

During the cherry blossom season, the Meguro River has breathtaking views of the trees next to the river which is one of Tokyo’s best areas to view. This has got to be one of the best experiences ever and a fantastic Instagram shot.

In the summertime, take a peaceful walk down the river and head south where you will encounter one of Tokyo's trendiest areas, Nakameguro, which has riverside bars, boutiques and restaurants.

neighborhood_overview:
Quietly residing just beyond the city’s inner circle, Meguro District attracts commuters, families, and artists who appreciate subtle charms over sonorous environs. Tokyoites tend to visit Meguro District’s most famous local destinations, the hip enclave of Nakameguro and the canal along the Meguro River. Despite its far-away residential feel, Meguro District never seems out of touch. Organic cafes, famous izakayas, repurposed vintage shops, and musty must-see bookstores generate enough buzz to sustain this understatedly cool neighborhood.

During the cherry blossom season, the Meguro River has breathtaking views of the trees next to the river which is one of Tokyo’s best areas to view. This has got to be one of the best experiences ever and a fantastic Instagram shot.

In the summertime, take a peaceful walk down the river and head south where you will encounter one of Tokyo's trendiest areas, Nakameguro, which has riverside bars, boutiques and restaurants.

My listing is in a quiet residential area, with a community of small shops and restaurants nearby. The apartment itself has a convenience store on the first floor, and there are at least 3 restaurants on the same street, including one right next door. There is also a supermarket within walking distance, so you are sure to never be in need.

The nearest station is Iidabashi, which has the Tozai, Yurakucho, Namboku, and Oedo lines. All lines are integral to the Tokyo subway system, and can get you to almost anywhere. The Oedo line goes directly to Shinjuku, one of the central hubs of Tokyo, while the Tozai takes you to Nihombashi, the Yurakucho to Ikebukuro and Ginza, and the Namboku to Meguro.

I was invited to be a host for Airbnb from my friend and challenged it with my interest. I have used homestay for several times and remembered it was very convenient and comfortable stay.
I’m attracted by how I can give people pleasure as well as I enjoy it.
Tokyo’s attraction is that each city has very unique characteristic so you can encounter special experience.
For example, Shinjuku is a town with buildings that shine lights at night, delicious food, and an adult town, so I would highly recommend to go there at night. There are many restaurants in upper floor that you can enjoy dinner with great night view. 
Shibuya as well as Harajuku is mecca for pop culture such as music and fashion and crowded with people who seek for “kawaii (cute)” thing. At midnight, young people who want to dance in the club get together. 
Other than that, Asakusa has “Skytree” as well as “Sensouji” which retains Edo period’s trace so you can see traditional culture and ordinary people’s life. 
Akihabara has anime, comic, cosplay, and game culture and I personally like this area because my job is a game designer and my hobby is playing a TV game as well. I’m proud of Japanese games so much in terms of high quality in video and clever story composition. 

Based on my house accessible to anywhere, I hope you will find a way to see a various side of Tokyo.

description:
As the title says, I have another bedroom available in my brand new house in Ikebukuro (you can check out my other listing for the first floor bedroom in the house). The room has a double bed and can fit either a single traveler, a couple, or two travelers by putting down an extra futon.

Everything in the house works perfectly- the water pressure, the gas range, the lights, etc. All of the furniture is brand-new as well. There is a high-speed wireless internet connection in the house, and I have Netflix and a PlayStation 3, so you can watch movies, TV shows, or play video games on
neighborhood_overview: It is kind of a quiet, upscale neighborhood with many other new houses around, yet it's only a short walk away from the hustle and bustle of Ikebukuro, one of the major hubs on the Yamanote line which circles the city. One of the great things about the location is that there is a Don Quixote shopping center only three minutes away. They have everything at this place, from alcohol to groceries, toiletries to amusement items, all at prices much lower than other retail shops.
host_about:
Hello everyone, allow me to describe myself.  I'm a Canadian guy from a place called Peterborough, Ontario (about 1.5 hours east of Toronto).  I've been living in Tokyo for the past 13 years. Azabu-Juban is a lively residential area in central Tokyo with a mixture of Japanese shops, restaurants and bars. The convenience of several supermarkets in a central location and the proximity of Hiroo and Roppongi make it one of the more trendy and sought after residential areas of Tokyo. The main street, a block away from a busy road junction, has a village-like feel with cobbled stoned paving in some places. This atmosphere is created by the narrow streets, slow moving traffic, and a mixture of stores operated by older owners. It is known as Tokyo's most expensive upscale residential district; many artists, business people, and celebrities reside there. neighborhood_overview:
AREA
My house is called Grape's NAGAYA(葡萄の長屋) well located in Kyojima area only a 7-minute walk to KEISEI-HIKIFUNE Station from where you can easily get to Haneda or Narita Airport within around 60 mins. And any spots in Tokyo can be reached in 30 mins. My house will be an optimal for you as a base during your trip here!~
This area remains many elements that are quite historical。 You can experience local life in キラキラ商店街(a small walking street good for shopping and wandering).
host_about:
Hi there! I am Naomasa,an architect.
Grape's NAGAYA is one of my architecture works.This small hotel was built in 2017!
My house is in an area called Kyojima where you can catch a train to Asakusa in 6 mins,or to Tokyo Tower which is known as the tallest tower in Japan in only 2 mins.
Following I am going to present my favorite Kyojima area more bit. This area is quite close to core parts of Tokyo yet differ from other modern streets,Kyojima has its own style and very unique!
About this Kyojima town,there is an old story. 
Once upon a time, the general of the Edo period used to visited this town to see the Japanese garden, watch cherry blossoms, and hunt the birds.Which made this place full of traditional Japanese features. 
There is an old Japanese style of life here, such as the wooden houses,the winding narrow roads,the unique foods.and the friendly neighborhoods who feel like knowing each other for a long time.When you go to the shops, you will meet the lovely and friendly neighborhoods. 
I recommend the shopping street "Kirakira-Shotengai". 
There are many unique shops here selling local food,which may surprise you. 
I prepared an original map which contains some only-local-people-knew restaurants and historical sights.I made it in English.Hope you like it. 


大家好,我是金谷直政｡是一名建筑师｡
这栋小小的酒店｢葡萄的长屋｣(Grape's NAGAYA)是我在2017年自己亲手设计打造建成的｡
坐电车到浅草6分钟,到东京晴空塔2分钟,这里是被称为京岛的街道｡
请允许我向大家介绍一下｡京岛离东京的中心虽然非常近,但并不是像一般的市中心那样到处矗立着现代化的高楼大厦｡
这片区域在以前是江户时代的将军经常来访,参观日本的庭园､赏樱､狩猎的地方｡
木造的住宅,曲折狭小的的通道,独特的食物,还有日常朝夕相处互相理解互相关照的近邻｡
就算是现在也能感受到这种浓浓的温馨氛围｡如果您有时间去到附近的商店,我觉得您会在很大几率上会遇到非常亲切且很棒的当地人｡
特别推荐｢KIRAKIRA商店街｣｡有很多卖着独特食材的特色小店｡相信一定会让您大吃一惊｡
另外我还为您准备了记载着只有当地人知道的食堂､历史､观光地的地图｡
我非常期待与您能够马上见面｡


안녕하세요 저는 카나야 나오마사입니다. 건축가로 일하고 있습니다.
작은 호텔"포도의 숙소"(Grape's NAGAYA)는 제가 디자인 하고 2017년에 완공되었습니다!
이곳은 아사쿠사까지 전차로 6분 도쿄 스카이 트리(일본에서 가장 높은 타워)까지 2분 쿄지마라는 지역입니다.
제가 좋아하는 멋진 쿄지마에 대해서 소개합니다.쿄지마는 도쿄의 중심에 가깝지만 어디에나 있는 현대적인 거리는 아닙니다.

이 지역은 과거에는 에도 시대의 장군이 방문해서, 일본의 정원을 보거나, 벚꽃을 보거나,새를 사냥하했던 지역입니다.
목조 주택, 좁고 구불구불한 길,독특한 음식,그리고 오랫동안 서로를 알고 지냈던 기분이 드는 옛날 일본 스타일이 있습니다.
가게에 가면 멋지고 친근한 사람들을 만날 수 있을겁니다.

특히 쇼핑거리"키라키라 상가"를 추천합니다.현지의 식재료를 파는 독특한 가게가 많이 있습니다.
당신을 놀라게 할지도 모릅니다.
현지의 사람만이 알고 있는 식당과 역사적 명소가 포함되어 있는 오리지날의 지도를 준비했습니다.
하루 빨리 여러분과 만나고 싶습니다.


こんにちは､私は金谷直政です｡建築家として働いています｡
小さなﾎﾃﾙ｢葡萄の長屋｣(Grape's NAGAYA)は自分でﾃﾞｻﾞｲﾝしまし2017年に建てました!
ここは､浅草(浅草)まで電車で6分､東京ｽｶｲﾂﾘｰ(日本で一番高いﾀﾜｰ)まで2分､京島という町になります｡
私の大好きな素敵な京島について紹介します｡京島は東京の中心に近いですが､どこにでもあるような近代的な街にはなっていません｡
この地域は､かつては江戸時代の将軍が訪れ､日本の庭園を見たり､桜を見たり､鳥を狩ったりしていましたｴﾘｱです｡
木造住宅､狭い曲がりくねった道､ﾕﾆｰｸな食べ物､そして長い間お互いを知り合っているような気持ちのある人たちのような古い日本のｽﾀｲﾙがあります｡お店に行くと素敵で親しみやすい人たちに出会うことができると思います｡
特に､ｼｮｯﾋﾟﾝｸﾞ街｢ｷﾗｷﾗ商店街｣をお勧めします｡地元の食材を売っているﾕﾆｰｸなお店がたくさんあります｡あなたを驚かせるかもしれません｡
地元の人だけが知っている食堂や歴史的な名所が含まれているｵﾘｼﾞﾅﾙの地図を用意しました｡
すぐにあなたに会いたいと願っています

host_about:
Hi there! I am Naomasa,an architect.
Grape's NAGAYA is one of my architecture works.This small hotel was built in 2017!
My house is in an area called Kyojima where you can catch a train to Asakusa in 6 mins,or to Tokyo Tower which is known as the tallest tower in Japan in only 2 mins.
Following I am going to present my favorite Kyojima area more bit. This area is quite close to core parts of Tokyo yet differ from other modern streets,Kyojima has its own style and very unique!
About this Kyojima town,there is an old story. 
Once upon a time, the general of the Edo period used to visited this town to see the Japanese garden, watch cherry blossoms, and hunt the birds.Which made this place full of traditional Japanese features. 
There is an old Japanese style of life here, such as the wooden houses,the winding narrow roads,the unique foods.and the friendly neighborhoods who feel like knowing each other for a long time.When you go to the shops, you will meet the lovely and friendly neighborhoods. 
I recommend the shopping street "Kirakira-Shotengai". 
There are many unique shops here selling local food,which may surprise you. 
I prepared an original map which contains some only-local-people-knew restaurants and historical sights.I made it in English.Hope you like it. 


大家好,我是金谷直政｡是一名建筑师｡
这栋小小的酒店｢葡萄的长屋｣(Grape's NAGAYA)是我在2017年自己亲手设计打造建成的｡
坐电车到浅草6分钟,到东京晴空塔2分钟,这里是被称为京岛的街道｡
请允许我向大家介绍一下｡京岛离东京的中心虽然非常近,但并不是像一般的市中心那样到处矗立着现代化的高楼大厦｡
这片区域在以前是江户时代的将军经常来访,参观日本的庭园､赏樱､狩猎的地方｡
木造的住宅,曲折狭小的的通道,独特的食物,还有日常朝夕相处互相理解互相关照的近邻｡
就算是现在也能感受到这种浓浓的温馨氛围｡如果您有时间去到附近的商店,我觉得您会在很大几率上会遇到非常亲切且很棒的当地人｡
特别推荐｢KIRAKIRA商店街｣｡有很多卖着独特食材的特色小店｡相信一定会让您大吃一惊｡
另外我还为您准备了记载着只有当地人知道的食堂､历史､观光地的地图｡
我非常期待与您能够马上见面｡


안녕하세요 저는 카나야 나오마사입니다. 건축가로 일하고 있습니다.
작은 호텔"포도의 숙소"(Grape's NAGAYA)는 제가 디자인 하고 2017년에 완공되었습니다!
이곳은 아사쿠사까지 전차로 6분 도쿄 스카이 트리(일본에서 가장 높은 타워)까지 2분 쿄지마라는 지역입니다.
제가 좋아하는 멋진 쿄지마에 대해서 소개합니다.쿄지마는 도쿄의 중심에 가깝지만 어디에나 있는 현대적인 거리는 아닙니다.

이 지역은 과거에는 에도 시대의 장군이 방문해서, 일본의 정원을 보거나, 벚꽃을 보거나,새를 사냥하했던 지역입니다.
목조 주택, 좁고 구불구불한 길,독특한 음식,그리고 오랫동안 서로를 알고 지냈던 기분이 드는 옛날 일본 스타일이 있습니다.
가게에 가면 멋지고 친근한 사람들을 만날 수 있을겁니다.

특히 쇼핑거리"키라키라 상가"를 추천합니다.현지의 식재료를 파는 독특한 가게가 많이 있습니다.
당신을 놀라게 할지도 모릅니다.
현지의 사람만이 알고 있는 식당과 역사적 명소가 포함되어 있는 오리지날의 지도를 준비했습니다.
하루 빨리 여러분과 만나고 싶습니다.


こんにちは､私は金谷直政です｡建築家として働いています｡
小さなﾎﾃﾙ｢葡萄の長屋｣(Grape's NAGAYA)は自分でﾃﾞｻﾞｲﾝしまし2017年に建てました!
ここは､浅草(浅草)まで電車で6分､東京ｽｶｲﾂﾘｰ(日本で一番高いﾀﾜｰ)まで2分､京島という町になります｡
私の大好きな素敵な京島について紹介します｡京島は東京の中心に近いですが､どこにでもあるような近代的な街にはなっていません｡
この地域は､かつては江戸時代の将軍が訪れ､日本の庭園を見たり､桜を見たり､鳥を狩ったりしていましたｴﾘｱです｡
木造住宅､狭い曲がりくねった道､ﾕﾆｰｸな食べ物､そして長い間お互いを知り合っているような気持ちのある人たちのような古い日本のｽﾀｲﾙがあります｡お店に行くと素敵で親しみやすい人たちに出会うことができると思います｡
特に､ｼｮｯﾋﾟﾝｸﾞ街｢ｷﾗｷﾗ商店街｣をお勧めします｡地元の食材を売っているﾕﾆｰｸなお店がたくさんあります｡あなたを驚かせるかもしれません｡
地元の人だけが知っている食堂や歴史的な名所が含まれているｵﾘｼﾞﾅﾙの地図を用意しました｡
すぐにあなたに会いたいと願っています

Chatting

I work in Ikebukuro & Akihabara, Tokyo.
I was brought up & born in Osaka.
Now I am mum of 3 years old son.
Beside childcare and work, I am hosting.
I love yoga and piano,
I love traveling abroad, too. Asia,Europe etc... 
Recently I went to Shanghai.
My house, groups are particularly welcome!

For me who was brought up in Osaka, I think TOKYO is worthwhile as a tourist destination as the whole city. Like Paris.
UENO, AKIHABARA, SKYTREE, ASAKUSA, GINZA, SHINJYUKU, SHIBUYA, HARAJYUKU, ROPPONGI, IKEBUKURO, etc..It is crowded with lots of people and it is lively."KAWAII" and "YASUI" are all included.
On the other hand, for those who want to relax slowly in a relatively vacant place, I would like to recommend a garden or a park.
Among them, RIKUGIEN & KOISHIKAWA KORAKUEN are called 2 big gardens in Edo, where people who know it can enjoy traditional Japanese gardens.
And Ueno Park is close to AMEYOKO, it is a very favorite place with zoos, museums, science museums and so on.
Landscape has been maintained for a long time as a castle town of Edo from around our house,too. Called"SHITAMACHI".
Please enjoy such Tokyo by all means.

The country I have traveled to is : Korea, China, Thailand, Hawaii, Guam, Germany, France, Italy, Austria.
I love to touch different cultures.

neighborhood_overview:
【檜原村の概要】
檜原村は都心から最短で約90分で来ることができる「都心に一番近い村」です。懐かしい里山の風景が広がり、村の約90%が山林で占められています。一年を通して登山やハイキングに訪れるお客さまが多いエリアです。

春から秋にかけてアユやヤマメなどの渓流釣り、夏には川遊び、サイクリングが盛んでヒルクライムの練習には最適です。
秋は川の流れも穏やかになり紅葉も美しく、多くの観光客が訪れます。
冬は気温が都心より5度ほど低く、ひっそり静かに時間を過ごせます。寒い朝には村の観光スポット「払沢の滝」が氷結する様子も見ることができます。


【檜原村の観光情報】
建物から徒歩約3分の場所には「檜原村観光協会」の情報センターがありますので、村内の様々な情報に触れることができます。
・檜原村観光協会(檜原村403)


【食事について】
充実したキッチンがありますので、そこで料理をしていただくのがオススメです。各種調理器具、コンロ(3口)、電子レンジ、トースター、コーヒードリッパーなどを備えてあります。


【お買い物】
地元食材を扱う物産店、酒屋、パン屋、村内唯一の(ミニ)スーパーなどが徒歩圏内にあります。

・ミニスーパー「かあべえ屋」/檜原村466-2/営業時間10:00~20:00/無休
・酒屋「谷合商店」/檜原村421/営業時間9:00~19:00/月曜定休
・パン屋「森の風°(ぷう)」/檜原村18/営業時間:10:00~20:00/定休日:木と第2第4水曜日


【お食事処】
徒歩圏内に手打ちラーメンの名店やそば店、車で5分ほどの場所にイタリアン、地元食材の定食屋などがあります。

neighborhood_overview:
Shinjuku (新宿) is one of the 23 city wards of Tokyo, but the name commonly refers to just the large entertainment, business and shopping area around Shinjuku Station.
The closest underground station is Shinjuku-sanchome Station (新宿三丁目), which has lies on the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi and the Toei Shinjuku Lines in Shinjuku Ward of Tokyo. It is located just south-east of Shinjuku Station and is connected to it by an underground passageway and a shopping mall. Directly above Shinjuku-sanchome subway station is Isetan Department Store , one of the most famous department stores in Tokyo. Prices at Isetan range from medium to high. The basement floor is the food hall with a large array of different food counters.

neighborhood_overview:
Quietly residing just beyond the city’s inner circle, Meguro District attracts commuters, families, and artists who appreciate subtle charms over sonorous environs. Tokyoites tend to visit Meguro District’s most famous local destinations, the hip enclave of Nakameguro and the canal along the Meguro River. Despite its far-away residential feel, Meguro District never seems out of touch. Organic cafes, famous izakayas, repurposed vintage shops, and musty must-see bookstores generate enough buzz to sustain this understatedly cool neighborhood.

During the cherry blossom season, the Meguro River has breathtaking views of the trees next to the river which is one of Tokyo’s best areas to view. This has got to be one of the best experiences ever and a fantastic Instagram shot.

In the summertime, take a peaceful walk down the river and head south where you will encounter one of Tokyo's trendiest areas, Nakameguro, which has riverside bars, boutiques and restaurants.

Sugamo is one of the most charming district in Tokyo with a traditional Japanese style old street which famously caters to the elderly. The symbol of the district is a 800-meter-long Jizo Dori shopping street, affectionately known as the "Old Ladies' Harajuku" in lighthearted comparison to the Harajuku district's status as one of Japan's foremost youthful shopping and fashion destinations. It has lined by over 200 shops that sell very unique & traditional clothing, food and other goods. Many shops are bookmarked in travel guide books. If you like traditional Japanese sweets, you definitely want to try Shio-Daifuku, pounded rice cakes that contain sweet bean paste and salt to moderate the sweetness.
If you are interested in local events, there are demonstration celebrated by the residents four times a month that is so lively and interesting. You will never forget it if you have a chance to watch.
Flower shop, temple, shrine, supermarket as well as the art wares are everywhere

description:
数か月間だけ部屋を借りたいと思ったことはありませんか？　例えば、
・海外から帰国する際の自主隔離場所を確保したい
・家族に高齢者や受験性が居るので家庭内感染を避けるために職場の近くに部屋を借りたい
・気に入った部屋が見つかるまでの間のテンポラリーな滞在場所を確保してじっくり部屋探ししたい

こちらは、山手線の新大久保駅から徒歩でたったの３分、新宿、渋谷、池袋などの都内の主要駅まで山手線1本で行く事ができますので、お仕事やショッピングに大変便利です。

近くにはアジア各国のレストランやお店が多くありますので、食事や買い物をお楽しみいただけます。

また、貸自転車も2台ご用意しておりますので、ちょっとした買物に便利です。

数か月間だけ部屋を借りたいと思ったことはありませんか？　例えば、
・家の建て替えやリフォームの間だけ住む部屋を借りたい

description:
基本的に２名様からのご利用となります。１名様のお申込みについては、必ず宿にご相談ください。 ゲストハウス「青龍kibako」は、JR青梅駅から徒歩3分という便利な場所に位置し、昭和の香りが漂う青梅の散策や御岳山など奥多摩への観光の拠点として利用できます。バーべキューや川遊びを楽しめる多摩川はすぐ近く、近隣にゴルフ場も多くあります。国際色豊かな歓楽街として有名な福生にも近く、ナイトライフを楽しむこともできます。
「青龍kibako」の建物は昭和2年に建築され、築約90年の建物です。戦前の商業建築を今に残す歴史的建造物として、店舗部分一棟は、国登録有形文化財、青梅市景観形成重要資源に指定されています。建築された昭和初期の雰囲気を体感することをコンセプトの一つとし、意識した内観の作りとなっています。
旧青梅街道に面しており、行事の多い青梅の中でも、目の前で青梅大祭や青梅マラソン、夏の花火などを楽しむことができます。
ミニコンサートやワークショップ、絵画展示なども行えるカフェを併設し、ゲストハウスの共有部分にもなっています。宿泊しながら勉強会や宴会の場所などとしても利用できます。

Guest access

但し、登録有形文化財に指定されている和室は、繊細で傷つきやすい箇所もありますので、ご注意ください。

Other things to note
・旅館業法に基づき、簡易宿所営業許可を取得しています。

・必需品は揃っていますが、タオル・バスタオル等はご用意ください。

neighborhood_overview:
★AREA★
This apartment is located close to Ikebukuro station-- just a 3 minute walk away. Being in the center of one of the most busy cities in Tokyo, there are more than enough places for you to visit.
The Sunshine 60 building, for example, is a great place to go. It is the center of the famed Sunshine City, and has a large observatory deck on the 60th floor, from where you can see all of Ikebukuro and beyond. Sunshine City itself is also a fantastic facility- you can find anything from museums, aquarium, planetarium, theater, and a shopping mall.
Right by the Sunshine 60 building, there is a park. It is an oasis in the middle of the busy city, and a good place to take a break from the fun.
Ikebukuro is also known for its many restaurants and taverns, where you can have delicious meals in various cuisines. There is also a large supermarket in front of the apartment, so you should have no problems in terms of daily life.

Akihabara gained the nickname Akihabara Electric Town (秋葉原電気街 Akihabara Denki Gai) shortly after World War II for being a major shopping center for household electronic goods and the post-war black market.Nowadays, Akihabara is considered by many to be an otaku cultural center and a shopping district for video games, anime, manga, and computer goods. I was invited to be a host for Airbnb from my friend and challenged it with my interest. I have used homestay for several times and remembered it was very convenient and comfortable stay.
I’m attracted by how I can give people pleasure as well as I enjoy it.
Tokyo’s attraction is that each city has very unique characteristic so you can encounter special experience.
For example, Shinjuku is a town with buildings that shine lights at night, delicious food, and an adult town, so I would highly recommend to go there at night. There are many restaurants in upper floor that you can enjoy dinner with great night view. 
Shibuya as well as Harajuku is mecca for pop culture such as music and fashion and crowded with people who seek for “kawaii (cute)” thing. At midnight, young people who want to dance in the club get together. 
Other than that, Asakusa has “Skytree” as well as “Sensouji” which retains Edo period’s trace so you can see traditional culture and ordinary people’s life. 
Akihabara has anime, comic, cosplay, and game culture and I personally like this area because my job is a game designer and my hobby is playing a TV game as well. I’m proud of Japanese games so much in terms of high quality in video and clever story composition. 

Based on my house accessible to anywhere, I hope you will find a way to see a various side of Tokyo.

ゲストハウス「青龍kibako」は、昭和の香りが漂う青梅の散策や御岳山など奥多摩への観光の拠点として利用できます。また、川遊びを楽しめる多摩川はすぐ近く、近隣にゴルフ場も多くあります。
青龍kibako の建物は昭和2年に建築され、築約90年の建物です。戦前の商業建築を今に残す歴史的建造物として、店舗部分一棟は、国登録有形文化財、青梅市景観形成重要資源に指定されています。建築された昭和初期の雰囲気を体感することをコンセプトの一つとし、意識した内観の作りとなっています。
旧青梅街道に面しており、行事の多い青梅の中でも、目の前で青梅大祭や青梅マラソン、夏の花火などを楽しむことができます。
ミニコンサートやワークショップ、絵画展示なども行えるカフェを併設し、ゲストハウスの共有部分にもなっています。宿泊しながら勉強会や宴会の場所などとしても利用できます。

Other things to note
・2名以上の場合のお申込みについては、先ず宿に連絡していただき、必ず空き状況を確認してからお申込みください。

neighborhood_overview:
Sugamo is the name of an area around Sugamo Jizo-dori in Toshima Ward, Tokyo.
To make their shopping a more pleasant one, benches and other recreational facilities are installed throughout the area. The original reason for Sugamo's popularity is found at Koganji Temple halfway down the shopping street. The small temple is home to the highly popular Togenuki Jizo statue, which depicts the popular Jizo Bodhisattva and is thought to help heal ailments.

Even though there are a lot of elderly here, there are some shops that cater to the youth. On the 4th day of every month, there is a stall fair conducted, so it is a chance to learn about new shops. Not far from the shopping street, near Koshinzuka Station, Sugamo Koshindo Festival is held every spring. In addition, near JR Sugamo Station, there is Shinsei-ji Temple, dedicated to a jizo (Buddhist deity).

Tokyo’s attraction is that each city has very unique characteristic so you can encounter special experience.

Shibuya as well as Harajuku is mecca for pop culture such as music and fashion and crowded with people who seek for “kawaii (cute)” thing. At midnight, young people who want to dance in the club get together.

Based on my house accessible to anywhere, I hope you will find a way to see a various side of Tokyo.

neighborhood_overview:
Tokyo’s coolest neighbourhood revealed – and it’s near Shibuya

Posted: Wednesday September 18 2019, 2:31pm

After combining the knowledge of more than 27,000 people around the world (who took part in the 2019 Time Out Index survey) and the expertise of local Time Out editors and city experts, we have now uncovered the world’s 50 coolest neighbourhoods – and one Tokyo district made the list. This also means the neighbourhood is officially the coolest in Tokyo. No, it’s not Shinjuku, or last year’s Yanaka, or Shibuya, but it’s close. In fact, it’s just six minutes away from Shibuya Station on the Keio-Inokashira Line. It’s… Shimokitazawa!


Affectionately known as ‘Shimokita’ by the locals, the neighbourhood is a favourite haunt of Tokyo’s creative and fashion sets, who come here for the vintage and consignment shops, record stores, independent cafés, restaurants and bars, as well as the seasonal street festivals.

neighborhood_overview:
SANNO, Ota-ku is an area full of downtown flavors in Tokyo. The Omori Ginza shopping street near the east exit of the Omori station
has been there since 1876. This shopping street is full of century-aged shops such as Izakaya Fujikawa etc. We are sure that you can experience the mixing modern and traditional Japanese cultures here.

Furthermore, there are different types of restaurants, convenience stores and shops here in the Ikegami-Dori which is near the Omori station. Such as Tempura Tendon Tenya and MEGA Don Quijote, etc.
It will be so convenient for you to buy souvenirs and shop here.

Besides the shopping street, Reggae bar yaman, Asian Taste Ain't No. etc can provide you an incredible nightlife here in Sanno.
host_about:
AOCA is the first licensed "Vacation Rentals by Owner", manage by WORLD POTENTIAL Co., Ltd Japan, license authorized by Japanese Government!
It's a brand-new apartment in Tokyo where you can stay and enjoy the modern Japanese architecture. Located in Ōta Ward with only 20 mins train from Haneda Airport.

AOCA has the dopest artworks in the global level, which will provide guests with unique cultural and artistic experiences. There are 17 rooms and each room is designed by different artists. AOCA is filled with artworks all around, the wall of the building, the entrance, the rooftop and more. Being surrounded by amazing artworks by talented and skilled artists is like visiting an art museum.

Also AOCA is curated by LQID, which is an international creative crew of art directors, videographers and photographers. AOCA is aiming to become the most famous stylish guest house in Tokyo.

neighborhood_overview: Ōtemachi (大手町) is a district of Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan. It is located north of Tokyo Station and Marunouchi, east of the Imperial Palace, west of Nihonbashi and south of Kanda. It is the location of the former site of the village of Shibazaki, the most ancient part of Tokyo. Ōtemachi is known as a center of Japanese journalism, housing the main offices of three of the "big five" newspapers as well as being a key financial center and headquarters for large Japanese corporations. It is also the location of the Japan Postal Museum. Within a 5 minute walk you are exposed to some great local Japanese cuisine. Walk a bit further within 10 minutes and you will reach the Kanda area which has plenty of restaurants, pubs, karaoke bars and local Japanese business people.

neighborhood_overview:
浅草駅に近く、観光スポット、グルメスポット、ショッピングスポットが盛りだくさん♪
また、浅草駅からは銀座、築地、秋葉原、渋谷、上野などへも簡単にアクセスできます♪

東京一の観光スポットといえば浅草!
雷門で待ち合わせして、仲見世通りを通って浅草寺まで。
近くには浅草神社や伝法院通りもあります。
スカイツリーにも近く、人力車での観光も可能です(要予約)。
下町情緒や昔の雰囲気を味わえる随一の場所です！

浅草周辺は食べ歩きにも最適です♪
日本伝統の和菓子はじめ、たくさんの露店ではテレビで特集されているような美味しいお店で溢れています♪
古くから続く店も多く、寿司屋、天ぷら、ラーメンといった定番の日本料理はじめ、ホッピー通りはお昼から飲める大衆酒場となっており、観光スポットとしても有名です。歩いて雰囲気を楽しむだけでもOk!

もちろんショッピングもできるので、数日かけて周るのがおすすめです♪
ドンキホーテ、無印良品、ユニクロ、ドラッグストア(マツモトキヨシ)、デパートも浅草からすべて徒歩圏内です!

宿は、浅草駅を出て、吾妻橋を渡って3分ほどです。
吾妻橋は、屋形船やアサヒビールの本社などを目的とした撮影スポットにもなっています！
宿の近くには、コンビニ、スーパー、コインランドリー、飲食店等もありますので、快適にお過ごしいただけます。

ぜひ、東京浅草へお越しの際はお声かけください♪

Our x-disciplinary team of entrepreneurs, designers, architects and dreamers are using hospitality as a platform to connect the travelling creative class with the local creative community. Through this initiative, we aim to inspire and empower the next generation of creators locally, and globally.

As examples of how we are doing this:
- Truly bespoke art rooms created by local artists
- Revenue share system that gives back to the artists
- In-house creative agency that involves both the local community and the travelling creators to work together on exciting projects

If you are interested in working with us, please get in touch!

name: BnA ART STUDIO - Hailer/Responder by 81 BASTARDS
description:
【Registered Property】Stay in an Art Piece, Support an Artist. BnA STUDIO Akihabara is an Art x Hospitality project produced by BnA (Bed&Art) Collective. Part of the profit goes to the artists who created the unique space. This room was created by 81 bastards, an artist collective based in Tokyo.(You'll be in one of the two different rooms designed by 81 basters, "Hailer" or "Responder") We provide full service (daily house cleaning, towel change)

The space
About the Artists:
81 BASTARDS, is an artist collective of 10 members, comprised of six painters, a tattoo artist, photographer, videographer and DJ. All born in the same year, 1981. They are considered one of the flag bearers of Tokyo's urban art scene.

About the Architect:
Keigo Fukugaki is a founder and CDO of BnA. Some of his known work are Facebook and Pinterest offices in Tokyo. He was selected as one of 40 emerging designers by the Interior Design Magazine in 2018.

neighborhood_overview: The house is situated in Kyojima district of Sumida ward, and this area is often called “a town saved from burning”. While other areas in Tokyo were devastated by the great fire after the large scale air raid in 1945, this town miraculously survived. So after the war, this Kyojima district which was still functioning, unlike other parts of Tokyo, became a crucial part of the capital city as a pillar in reconstruction works. Then this area received a large number of people. It is said that this was one of the most densely populated areas in Asia at that period, and those people created a vibrant local culture. Kyojima district with its shopping center “Kira-kira Tachibana Ginza” has continued to change as time goes by. Nowadays we do not see the same energy, like once brought by the congestion of people, but still we are nourishing our local culture which is unique and creative.

description:
自然素材で温かみのある家具、そして木、和紙、織物などの手仕事クラフトのインテリアでおくつろぎください。完全個別のエントランスかつ独立型のワンルーム（1階）です。目の前のコンビニのほか、周辺には商店街や最新のショッピングモールもございます。新型コロナ感染対策の清掃スタンダードを順守し、安心安全かつ快適にご滞在いただけるものと確信しております。和のしつらえと木のぬくもり、オニタビハウスへようこそ。

The space
木を中心にした温かみのあるお部屋です。雪見障子（和紙とガラスを組み合わせた和風の格子戸）、無垢板のフローリング、Ｙチェア、アイランドキッチン＆木製テーブルなど、和風インテリアを心掛けました。またハンガーラックやタオル掛け、棚受け、暖簾など我々ホストのDIY作品をご笑覧ください。

Guest access
お部屋は独立型ワンルームですので、室内はプライベートスペースとしてご自由にお使いいただけます。鍵はチェックイン、チェックアウトの時にホストとの直接対面でのお渡し、御戻しとなります。急用等でホスト不在の場合は、門柱のキーボックスを利用させていただきます。ボックスの暗証番号はメール等でお伝えします。

Other things to note
申し訳ありませんが、当施設にはスペースの関係で洗濯機がありません。その代わりに、手洗い用の洗剤、ミニ洗濯板、洗い桶、脱水機をご用意しました。少量の洗濯物であれば、十分に対応可能です。なお、最新設備のコインランドリーも徒歩5分の所にあります。

name: CITAN Hostel A bed in 8 Female Dormitory
description:
CITAN is a seven-story hostel with its basement floor, located in Nihon-bashi area that has seen many journeys along the Five Routes “Gokaido” since Edo era.

Even in these modern days, it still offers you a great access to the multiple lines, necessary to fully enjoy the metropolitan life as well as the good old Shitamachi area in Tokyo.

Our hostel has its original coffee shop, Berth Coffee on the first floor, and the bar and dining restaurant on the basement floor.

Your journey will be promised with a lot of great people from all over the world as well as our nice staff, fine drinks and food made with the warmest heart of ours.

The space
This is private room without shower and toilet.
You can use shared bathroom for 24 hours also common space and laundry are available anytime.
Our reception open between 8am and 11pm.
All of our staff are very friendly and helpful. Please feel free to ask us if you need a help
host_about:
CITAN is our brand new seven stories hostel located in Higashi-nihonbashi.
Nihonbashi was the initial starting point of Gokaido during the Edo era where five major highways connected Edo(current Tokyo) to the rest of Japan in which many journeys began in this town.
CITAN aims to be the starting point of every journey that connects the city and people in present time.

The museum has a permanent collection with an emphasis on photography, particularly the works of Kineo Kuwabara and Kōji Morooka. One of the district's landmarks is the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building, the center of Tokyo’s administration. With plenty of spots to see, the area is centered around JR Shinjuku Station, which serves 3.5 million passengers a day, the largest in Japan. The vicinity of the station’s East Exit is full of bustling streets such as Kabuki-cho and Golden-gai, and shopping areas such as department stores and large-scale stores. description:
我的房源靠近地铁站、餐廳和美食、方便的商圈、東新宿地鐵站A1出口。因為舒適的空間、舒適的床、廚房、獨立衛浴、熱鬧又便利的街區,您一定會愛上我的房源。我的房源適合情侶、商務旅客、有小孩 、老人的家庭。
房间在一层不需要爬楼梯哦！

The space
公寓的位置在寧靜巷內,周邊環境清優,位於一层楼.不需要爬楼梯、适合老人、孩子、冬天暖、夏天凉全面监控系统非常安全。
有小廚房,提供電磁爐、微波爐、熱水壺及厨房用品、餐具供房客使用。
★公寓位于新宿区的居民区内,最近地铁车站是东新宿站步行4分钟即可到达、新大久保站,步行约8分钟即可到达哦。周边餐厅、便利店和超市等等都很齐全,觅食、买日用品等很方便。
★这是一个设备齐全的公寓哦,公寓共有三个卧室、卧室1一张双人床、卧室2一张双人床.一张单人榻榻米床垫.卧室3一张双人床、一张单人榻榻米床垫、两个厕所、两个浴室、都是分开的哦！房间里设有超高的清电视机,有冰箱、微波炉、浴巾、毛巾、牙膏、牙刷、女人用品、男人刮胡刀、浴液、洗发水、护发素、洗澡巾、拖鞋、熨斗和吹风机等等,公寓内设有洗衣机带自动风干机.住我家民宿不需要带很多行李.公寓内一应俱全。
★公寓是我的一位设计师朋友帮忙设计的,客厅整体偏暖黄色色调,给人以怀旧感。卧室则配置了自然木质地板和几盆绿意葱葱的植株,满满森林氧气感~
附近的超市可很便利的買到食材、早餐。 附近有大久保商店街(大久保通り上)Eastside商場、食堂、麥當勞、便利店、超市...生活機能優,交通也便利。

Guest access
屋子内的所有物品都可以使用、但要爱惜哦！

Other things to note
房间设有自动登记平板电脑、没有预订的人员禁止入内、日本民宿法律法规出台、预订的人数和登记的人数必须一致、（请注意、如多出一人一旦被监控拍下将被加倍罚款）爱惜屋子内的一切物品！损害赔偿哦！

Thank you for seeing my profile!
Welcome to Japan! Hope you enjoy your trip in Japan!
I would like to thank you for choosing our room!

(About us)
We began airbnb in May of 2017.
DIY, which makes something and remakes, is a hobby. 
All the interiors of the room posted on airbnb were renovated by ourselves.
We also like traveling. So we decided to offer this room to everyone, thinking of providing a comfortable home for the traveler. We are very happy if everyone in this room can heal even a little tired body.

(Service)
We apologize for not being able to answer the phone soon. Because we have a job during the day, we are very busy.
Instead, We have a specialized team to contact you. They have the same thoughts as us. They are very friendly and kind.
If you have any question, please contact us via airbnb chat.
We will do the best hospitality for you!

This building has a history of nearly 50 years already.
However, after regular repair and remodeling, we have secured our safety, so do not worry.
Please use it carefully for the later people.
We like this building.

(Place)
The room is near the sky-tree tower which is the symbol of this area. Our picture was taken on the top floor of the sky-tree with the image character.
There are also many restaurants and convenience stores in the neighborhood. very convenient.
There is a local city “KIRA-KIRA shopping street" which can only be seen here, 5 minutes on foot. We’re surely waiting for wonderful encounters and discoveries there.

Have a nice day!

我們在2017年5月開始了airbnb｡愛好DIY｡所有在airbnb上發布的房間都由我們自己進行了翻新｡我們也喜歡旅行｡所以我們決定為旅行者提供一個舒適的家｡希望入住房間裡的每個人都可以治愈因旅途疲憊的身體｡我們感到非常高興｡

(服務)
對於無法盡快接聽電話,我們深表歉意｡因為我們白天有工作,所以我們很忙｡但是,我們擁有一個專業的團隊與您聯繫｡他們和我們有同樣的想法｡他們非常友好和善良｡
如果您有任何疑問,請通過airbnb chat與我們聯繫｡
我們將竭誠為您服務!

(建築)
這座建築外表有點舊｡但是,經過定期維修和改造後,我們確保了安全,所以不用擔心｡
請愛戴這座建築物和每個房間｡它也將長久於此等您再次歸來｡
我們很喜歡這座建築｡

(地方)
地點靠近天空樹塔,這是該地區的象徵｡附近還有許多餐館和便利店｡非常方便｡步行5分鐘,您將看到一個當地的購物街,叫“KIRA-KIRA購物街”｡在那裡,您或許會找到美妙的相遇和發現｡

祝您旅途愉快!

こんにちは!Charlesです｡
ﾌﾟﾛﾌｨｰﾙをご覧いただきありがとうございます!

私たちは､2017年の5月にairbnbを始めました｡
何かを作ったりﾘﾒｲｸするDIYが趣味で､airbnbに掲載している部屋の内装は全て自分たちで考案し､ﾘﾌｫｰﾑしました｡私たちもよく旅行をするので､旅人の気持ちがよくわかります｡旅人のために､快適な家を提供したいと考え､この部屋を皆さんに提供することに決めました｡この部屋で皆さんが少しでも疲れた体を癒すことができたら､とても嬉しいです｡

あなたのために､最高のおもてなしをします!

この建物は古いが､定期的修繕とﾘﾌｫｰﾑを経て､安全性を確保しておりますので､ご心配はいりません｡

(場所)
部屋はこの地域のｼﾝﾎﾞﾙであるｽｶｲﾂﾘｰの近くにあります｡

楽しい一日を過ごしてください!

내 프로필을 보아 주셔서 감사합니다!

우리 방을 선택해 주셔서 고맙습니다.

(회사 소개)
우리는 2017 년 5 월에 에어 비앤비를 시작했습니다.
뭔가를 만들고 재창조하는 DIY는 취미입니다.에어 비앤비에 게시 된 객실의 모든 인테리어는 스스로 개조되었습니다.우리는 또한 여행을 좋아합니다. 그래서 우리는이 방을 모든 사람에게 제공하기로 결정하여 여행자에게 편안한 집을 제공 할 생각입니다. 이 방에있는 모든 사람들이 조금 피곤한 몸을 치료할 수 있다면 매우 행복합니다.

우리는 곧 전화를받지 못해 사과드립니다. 낮에는 일자리가 있기 때문에 우리는 매우 바쁩니다.대신, 우리는 당신에게 연락 할 수있는 전문 팀을 가지고 있습니다. 그들은 우리와 같은 생각을 가지고 있습니다. 그들은 매우 친절하고 친절합니다.
질문이 있으시면 airbnb 채팅으로 문의하십시오.
우리는 당신을 위해 최고의 환대를 할 것입니다!

나중에 사람들을 위해 조심해서 사용하십시오.
우리는이 건물이 마음에 듭니다.

(장소)
방은이 지역의 상징 인 하늘 나무 탑 근처에 있습니다. 우리의 사진은 이미지 캐릭터가있는 하늘 나무의 꼭대기 층에서 찍혔습니다.또한 이웃에는 많은 레스토랑과 편의점이 있습니다. 매우 편리합니다.걸어서 5 분 정도 밖에 걸리지 않는 "키라 키라 (Kira-Kira) 쇼핑 거리"가 있습니다. 우리는 거기에서 멋진 만남과 발견을 확실하게 기다리고 있습니다.

description:
东京旅馆，隶属日本“樱旅行”集团旗下直营酒店，地理位置得天独厚，酒店前的駒込公园，是日本樱花“染井吉野”的发祥地，每逢一年一度的樱花时节，景色让人美不胜收，仿佛置身在花海里。馆内每间客房均配有阳台，可欣赏公园内四季美景，令人心旷神怡。
酒店于2017年12月竣工，2018年3月开始投入使用，2018年5月1日正式开始营业。新建旅馆全部采用最新环保材料全新装修，房间定期消毒，洗漱用具随时换新，使用备常碳牙刷。洗护用品使用日本最人气的马油沐浴露及无需使用护发素的马油洗发水。
酒店共有5层，共有2套复式家庭房，8个标房，每个房间都配有独立卫生间和淋浴房，迷你小厨房，阳台。可容纳15-20人旅行小团队。
酒店配有无线网络、全自动带烘干和熨烫功能的智能洗衣机、空调、淋浴（干湿分离）、温水坐便器，微波炉、电视机，冰箱等，一应俱全 。旅馆20米处有就有自动饮料贩卖机。
東京旅馆采用建筑钢筋铁骨造，坚固耐用，隔音效果好。
每间客房均配有密码锁，客人凭密码即可入住。每个客房门前有智能视屏对讲系统。住客安全有保障。

The space
301房间的阳台朝向公园，景观非常漂亮
两张单人床并列排放，并有伸缩功能，白天可以将床铺收缩，以便更好利用室内空间。
迷你厨房有冰箱微波炉可以用于简单加热食物，比酒店更有家的风味
淋浴房和厕所干湿分离，使用十分方便，提供最先进的温水坐便器为您的旅途带来美好的享受
此房型不接受单人的预订，如果1人也希望入住的情况下需要支付1.5人的费用。

Guest access
大堂，走廊，楼梯，客房。公共洗衣机

Other things to note
酒店只有行李运送电梯，旅客需要走楼梯。
如需使用智能洗衣机（洗涤烘干熨烫一次搞定）需要另外支付300日币/次。
如果单人需要入住此房型，需要支付1.5人的费用。

host_about:
我是明月｡爱读书爱旅行爱美食,在日本经营旅行社的一位中国传统女性｡喜欢日本的传统文化,也喜欢中国充满活力的生活｡经常往返中日之间,对两国文化有深刻的体验和理解｡
比起东京大阪这样的大城市,我最喜欢充满日本韵味的千年古城-京都｡据说京都才是日本人心灵的故乡,而京都各种古今融合的传统文化气息,更是吸引我在这里买房定居的理由｡酷爱美食的我,对日本各种美食餐厅和饮食流派非常有研究,如果需要介绍日本美食的,可以直接来咨询我,如果需要观光指南,交通指导,也不必客气,我会在最大范围内给予免费的建议｡爱美的姑娘如果要体验一下和服风情,我们酒店也有对面有琳琅满目的和服店可以选择,如果需要找有中国店员方便语言沟通交流的店铺也可以代为推荐｡无论是旅游,交通,住宿,美食,观光,相信我可以提供最贴心的建议和最好的服务,这些全是免费的哦!

"Asakusa"
Asakusa is the district around Senso-ji Temple and Asakusa Shrine. Many streets here are Japanese “shotengai”, shopping streets with lots of small shops. Asakusa has always attracted many visitors, who come not only to visit temples and shrines but also to see performances such as “kabuki” theater, “manzai” comedy, and “rakugo” storytelling. It gets crowded during the Sanja Matsuri, the Sumida River Fireworks, and the Asakusa Samba Carnival. Make sure to check the calendar for the many local festivals and events taking place each year. 日本の摩天楼､新宿新都心ｴﾘｱ(都庁を中心とした超高層ﾋﾞﾙ街)からほど近い､ｱｸｾｽ便利､新宿村ｽﾀｼﾞｵから目と鼻の先にある住宅街に3階建て一軒家を所有し､管理室と接続している完全分離型の宿泊施設を運営しています｡ﾎﾃﾙ旅館業の免許を取得しております｡東京への旅行､出張などに是非ご利用ください!

Hello! I am a Web Producer, Digital Branding & Marketing specialist, Event Production Coordinator, TV media interpreter (yes I wear many hats!) and a long-time resident of Shinjuku. I'm also the co-host/local correspondent of the popular "Doko Ga TV: JapanMania," an exciting, fun, family friendly Japanese lifestyle & travel TV show filmed in Japan and airing on Hawaii television KFVE the Home Team Ch.05. 

I was raised in the Philippines, attended schools in Japan and the United States and have been traveling frequently to Hawaii for work and R&R. I am an avid traveler and always in pursuit of planning the next journey. I have great love for movies, food, traveling, swimming, body-boarding, music or just sharing great conversation with friends around dinner tables. 

We have thought of everything to make your stay exceptionally memorable and an enjoyable retreat. We have also traveled a great deal in our lifetime and understand the frustrations tourists can experience, so when you're staying with us, we're always at your disposal. Just feel free to ask ANYTHING! :-)

We're also very laid back, sociable, friendly and we really enjoy meeting new people. We also love to share our favorite places to eat, drink and visit in the city with our guests. I work out of home and will be around all day and some evenings. So, if you need company, we will try to make ourselves available. But we're also happy to give you as much privacy and time alone as you would like. Your call! :-)  Your hosts are me and my mother, either of us (or sometimes both!) will be around all day.

I'm also quite a foodie and I love trying out new foods, places to eat in the city. So if you're looking for good places to eat or just wanna have a fun wicked night in the neighborhood, feel free to ask me.

neighborhood_overview:
Shinjuku Station is the world's busiest railway station, handling more than two million passengers every day. It is served by about a dozen railway and subway lines, closing the Seibu Shinjuku Line. Shinjuku is also one of Tokyo's major stops for long-distance highway buses. A large bus terminal, named Busta Shinjuku, is conveniently located on top of the railway station.
West of the station is Shinjuku's skyscraper district, home to many of Tokyo's tallest buildings, including several premier hotels and the twin towers of the Metropolitan Government Office, whose observation decks are open to the public for free.
Northeast of the station lies Kabukicho, Japan's largest and wildest red light district, while department stores, subterranean malls and electronic shops surround Shinjuku Station on all four sides, including the redeveloped Southern Terrace.

description:
Have you ever wondered how it would feel to live in Tokyo?
Strolling in a lovely park before breakfast, visiting the sites in local trains, going out for drink after relaxing in a bath...
Staying in my house will give you a whole different experience over staying in a hotel.
I would be glad to prepare Japanese dishes together and go out after supper with you, if you like.
On weekends I'll show you around the city for you to find the hidden gems of Tokyo.
FREE BIKE RENTAL !
CHERRY BLOSSOMS!

The space
The Space

Your air-conditioned room (3.5 x 2.3 m) has a clean double bed (2.1 x 1.4 m) , a small refrigerator and a desk.
The room has both a lock and a key chain.

My modest house is in Koganei, a residential area approximately 25 minutes from Shinjuku on the Chuo Line.
It has an earthquake-resistant steel-frame structure, contemporary facilities, and a free parking on the premises.

Guest acce

neighborhood_overview:
Ikebukuro (池袋) is one of Tokyo's multiple city centers, found around the northwestern corner of the Yamanote loop line. At the district's center stands Ikebukuro Station, a busy commuter hub traversed by three subway and multiple urban and suburban train lines. The station handles over a million passengers per day, making it the second busiest railway station surpassed only by Shinjuku Station.
Ikebukuro offers plenty of entertainment, shopping and dining opportunities. It is the battleground between the Tobu and Seibu conglomerates which operate large department stores on each side of the station, as well as train lines from Ikebukuro into the suburbs. Seibu furthermore has a stake in Sunshine City, a large shopping and entertainment complex not far from the station.

・気に入った部屋が見つかるまでの間のテンポラリーな滞在場所を確保してじっくり部屋探ししたい

こちらは、山手線の新大久保駅から徒歩でたったの３分、新宿、渋谷、池袋などの都内の主要駅まで山手線1本で行く事ができますので、お仕事やショッピングに大変便利です。

The space
コンクリート打ちっぱなしのお洒落なマンションの２階です。

ベッドルームにはクイーンサイズのベッドが用意されておりますので、カップルやご夫婦はでのご宿泊が可能です。またクィーンサイズベッドはセミシングルのベッド(幅85cm)に分離可能ですので友人同士での宿泊も可能です。キッチンには2口のガスレンジ、冷蔵庫、電子レンジ、炊飯器、トースター、電子ケトルなどの設備が充実しています。

数か月間だけ部屋を借りたいと思ったことはありませんか？　例えば、
・家の建て替えやリフォームの間だけ住む部屋を借りたい
・仕事で長期出張する時にホテル替わりに部屋を借りたい

Ōmori is one of many areas in Tokyo's largest ward, Ōta-ku, and was formerly home to the German International School before its relocation to Yokohama. neighborhood_overview:
You can enjoy having great food, shopping, and nightlife in Shinjuku.
West part of Shinjuku is Shinjuku's skyscraper district, home to many of Tokyo's tallest buildings, including several premier hotels and the twin towers of the Metropolitan Government Office, whose observation decks are open to the public for free.
East part of Shinjuku, Shinjuku Gyoen, you can have a rest, walk in the big calm garden. Also, walk to Kabukicho, Japan's largest and wildest red light district, while department stores, subterranean malls and electronic shops, Robot- Restaurant, Omoide-Yokocho-bars, Golden Gai, surround Shinjuku Station on all four sides, including the redeveloped Southern Terrace.
There are many department stores, Isetan, Takashimaya, Odakyu, Keio, Lumine, Myload, Yodobashi Camera, Bic Camera, Bikuro, Mu-Ji, OIOI.

name: 全新开张的东京旅馆 ·步行到JR站2分钟到池袋3站7分钟 徒步圈内生活超级便利精致带阳台榻榻米三人间
description:
东京旅馆，隶属日本“樱旅行”集团旗下直营精致酒店，地理位置得天独厚，酒店前的駒込公园，是日本樱花“染井吉野”的发祥地，每逢一年一度的樱花时节，景色让人美不胜收，仿佛置身在花海里。馆内每间客房均配有阳台，可欣赏公园内四季美景，令人心旷神怡。
酒店于2017年12月竣工，2018年3月开始投入使用，2018年5月1日正式开始营业。新建旅馆全部采用最新环保材料全新装修，房间定期消毒，洗漱用具随时换新，使用备常碳牙刷。洗护用品使用日本最人气的马油沐浴露及无需使用护发素的马油洗发水。
酒店共有5层，共有2套复式家庭房，8个标房，每个房间都配有独立卫生间和淋浴房，迷你小厨房，阳台。可容纳15-20人旅行小团队。
酒店配有无线网络、全自动带烘干和熨烫功能的智能洗衣机、空调、淋浴（干湿分离）、温水坐便器，微波炉、电视机，冰箱等，一应俱全 。旅馆20米处有就有自动饮料贩卖机。
東京旅馆采用建筑钢筋铁骨造，坚固耐用，隔音效果好。
每间客房均配有密码锁，客人凭密码即可入住。每个客房门前有智能视屏对讲系统。住客安全有保障。

Tokyo’s attraction is that each city has very unique characteristic so you can encounter special experience.

Shibuya as well as Harajuku is mecca for pop culture such as music and fashion and crowded with people who seek for “kawaii (cute)” thing. At midnight, young people who want to dance in the club get together.
